A '''holocron''' created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] was buried in the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. Despite dozens of attempts to retrieve the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[pyramid]] in which it was stored, the Holocron was never found until over a millennia after its burial. This was until a [[Darth Nox|former slave]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] managed to retrieve the artifact.
